merger_name: Accent Group – The Athlete’s Foot in Karrinyup, WA

acquirers.name: The Athlete’s Foot Australia Pty Ltd

party_page.name: The Athlete’s Foot Australia Pty Ltd

merger_description:
Accent Group Limited (**Accent**) is a footwear retailer and wholesaler, operating a multi-brand, omnichannel business model. Accent’s portfolio encompasses several brands and approximately 900 stores across Australia and New Zealand, as well as a number of online platforms. Its brands include The Athlete’s Foot, Skechers, Platypus, Hype DC, Stylerunner and others, covering categories from youth fashion to outdoor, designer and performance.

The Athlete’s Foot (Karrinyup) is a The Athlete’s Foot franchisee store operating under a franchise agreement with Accent. The store is located in Karrinyup, Western Australia. The Athlete’s Foot is a retail supplier of athletic and lifestyle footwear and accessories.

Accent proposes to acquire, through its subsidiary The Athlete’s Foot Australia Pty Ltd, the following assets of The Athlete’s Foot (Karrinyup):

(a) business records;

(b) plant and equipment;

(c) consumables; and

(d) stock on hand (the **Acquisition**).

determination_table_content.details:
Accent Group Limited (Accent) applied for a notification waiver in
respect of its proposed acquisition, through its subsidiary The
Athlete’s Foot Australia Pty Ltd, of the following assets of The
Athlete’s Foot (Karrinyup):
(a) business records;
(b) plant and equipment;
(c) consumables; and
(d) stock on hand,
as described in the transaction documents provided as part of the
application (the Acquisition).

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has
determined under section 51ABV(1)(a) of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.

The acquirer, Accent, is a footwear retailer and wholesaler, operating
a multi-brand, omnichannel business model. Accent’s portfolio
encompasses several brands and approximately 900 stores across
Australia and New Zealand, as well as a number of online platforms.
Its brands include The Athlete’s Foot, Skechers, Platypus, Hype DC,
Stylerunner, and others, covering categories from youth fashion to
outdoor, designer and performance.
The Athlete’s Foot (Karrinyup) is a The Athlete’s Foot franchisee
store that has been operating under a franchise agreement with
Accent. The store is located in Karrinyup, Western Australia. The
Athlete’s Foot is a retail supplier of athletic and lifestyle footwear
and accessories.
Both The Athlete’s Foot and other Accent brands (such as Skechers,
Platypus, Hype DC and Stylerunner) are active in the retail supply of
footwear in Australia.

In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition given:
a. the Acquisition involves the transfer from a franchisee to the
franchisor with no change in the number of The Athlete’s
Foot stores in the area
b. there are alternative suppliers of footwear, including sports
footwear, to customers in the local areas surrounding
Karrinyup and in Australia more broadly.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
